intent: Run the SyncYomi server from kuhy's own fork instead of the published image, so server-side changes reach the live service, and stop the setup script from breaking the shared Caddy edge on every re-run.
scope: Non-goal: changing SyncYomi's schema, credentials or the phone's sync settings
changes: SYNCYOMI_IMAGE defaults to the local build syncyomi-kuhy:local, overridable back to a registry tag; adds SYNCYOMI_SRC and the fork URL.

ensure_local_image() builds that image from ~/syncyomi-src (cloning the fork if absent) before the container starts, under DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 because the Dockerfile reads $BUILDPLATFORM; SYNCYOMI_REBUILD=1 forces a rebuild.
configure_caddy() now owns gitea/sites/<subdomain>.caddy instead of appending to the shared Caddyfile, deletes a legacy inline block, and validates the config before reloading.
Preflight installs git and docker-buildx alongside the existing packages.

verification.evidence: Second (idempotent) run: 'Local image syncyomi-kuhy:local already built', 'Caddy snippet already current', caddy validate+reload OK, report printed. The first run caught the bug this fixes: 'ambiguous site definition: kuhy-sync.duckdns.org'.

verification.command: docker ps --filter name=^syncyomi$ + docker logs syncyomi

verification.evidence: ok: 2163 manga, 69776 chapters, 1 categories, 23 sources (13346096 bytes) - unchanged across the image swap.

verification.command: TachiyomiSY 'Sync library' on the phone, then read docker logs + sync_data row
verification.evidence: 'Sync data replaced' at 14:42:34; payload length 13346096 before and after; https://kuhy-sync.duckdns.org/api/auth/onboard returns 403 (user exists).

risks: The deployed build is develop (v1.1.14 + dependency bumps), not the v1.1.11 image it replaced; schema stays at version 8 and internal/database is unchanged between those points, so no migration runs.
A machine without ~/syncyomi-src now clones the fork on first setup, which needs network and a Docker build (~4 min) instead of an image pull.
The Caddy snippet is only rewritten when its content differs, so hand edits to that file are overwritten by design.
rollback: After rollback, re-run the guard and confirm 2163 manga, then a phone sync round-trip.
